# Bot Detect System
This repository contains a Spring Boot backend and a Vue frontend skeleton for a malicious user detection and visual analysis system.
## Structure - bds: Spring Boot backend - bds-web: Vue 3 frontend
## Quick start
Backend (Spring Boot): - Configure database settings in bds/src/main/resources/application.properties - Run the application
Frontend (Vue): - Install dependencies and run the dev server
## Notes - Auth uses username + password (hash + salt) with JWT planned. - CORS and MyBatis-Plus pagination are configured.
